camber_limits: Table gives nominal magnitude; sign convention and tolerance not established. Do not apply to rear axles.
procedure: Level ground, tight wheel nuts, straight-ahead wheels; check steering arm fixing and linkage play first.
Roll slowly forward and back to reduce tyre deformation effects. Tread block height difference must not exceed 6 mm.
At wheel-axis height, measure A between inboard tyre surfaces behind the axle, at the 1040 mm reference diameter near the lower tread-block edge.
Roll through 180 degrees of wheel rotation, measure B similarly in front of the axle; toe is A minus B.
After a further quarter turn, repeat the measurement.
Adjust the side tie rods with opposite-handed end threads, equally at both ends for each axle.
limits: The printed first-axle loaded range is 8–14 mm; an OCR reading of 6–14 is rejected by inspecting the page.
This does not define wheel travel or unladen ride height.
The current native model does not simulate tyre pressure, compliance or qualified vehicle load. A static geometry comparison cannot satisfy the physical procedure.
